direccion: Mikagezukamachi 1-8-17, Higashinada, Kobe
descripcion: Maker of Fukuju, the sake served at the Nobel banquet since 2008. Its grounds bring together kura, restaurant and concert hall.

direccion: Tateishicho 2-10, Nishinomiya
descripcion: Brewery founded in 1662 in the Nishinomiya-go district, with its own sake museum and bulk sales at its Hakushika Classics shop.

direccion: Sumiyoshi Minamimachi 4-5-5, Higashinada, Kobe
descripcion: Brewery founded in 1743 in Nada and the largest sake producer in Japan. Keeps its wooden kura as a museum open to the public.

direccion: Nishinomiya
descripcion: Nishinomiya-go brewery and sole supplier of ritual sake to the Ise shrine since 1924. Works with the area's miyamizu water.

direccion: Nakayamatedori 1-12-4, Chuo, Kobe
descripcion: Brewery founded in 1659 in Nada, a reference for the dry kimoto style. Its site returned 403 at review time.

direccion: Uozaki Minamimachi 5-10-1, Higashinada, Kobe
descripcion: Nada brewery that gave rise to kyokai yeast number one and to the use of Masamune itself as a sake name. Its domain did not respond.
